"""One guard in front of every request.

1. **Shop hosts serve shop pages only.** `<name>.<APP_DOMAIN>` never answers /api, /internal,
   /assets, /build or /r: the app's API simply doesn't exist there. (The session cookie is
   host-only and isn't sent to shop hosts anyway; this is a second wall.)
2. **Origin check.** A state-changing /api request must come from the app's own origin
   (`Origin`, or else `Referer`). A request with neither is allowed only when it carries no
   cookie at all (command-line tools using the admin token).
3. **CSRF token.** If the request carries the session (or guest) cookie, it must also carry
   `X-CSRF-Token`, a value derived from that cookie which only our own pages can learn.
"""

import hmac
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, PlainTextResponse

from app.config import get_settings
from app.safety.access import csrf_for
from app.sites.hosts import normalize_host, subdomain_label

UNSAFE = {"POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"}
APP_ONLY = ("/api/", "/internal/", "/assets/", "/build", "/r/")
STALE = "This page is out of date. Please refresh it and try again."


def origin_of(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    u = urlsplit(value)
    return f"{u.scheme}://{u.netloc}".lower() if u.scheme and u.netloc else None


def refuse(message: str = STALE) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse({"detail": message}, status_code=403)


async def request_guard(request: Request, call_next):
    settings = request.app.dependency_overrides.get(get_settings, get_settings)()
    path = request.url.path
    on_shop_host = subdomain_label(normalize_host(request.headers.get("host", "")), settings) is not None
    if on_shop_host and (path.startswith(APP_ONLY) or path == "/api"):
        return PlainTextResponse("Not found", status_code=404)
    if request.method in UNSAFE and path.startswith("/api/"):
        origin = origin_of(request.headers.get("origin")) or origin_of(request.headers.get("referer"))
        cookie = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie) or request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)
        if origin is None:
            if cookie:
                return refuse()
        elif origin != settings.origin:
            return refuse()
        if cookie:
            sent = request.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "")
            valid = [csrf_for(v) for v in (request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie),
                                           request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)) if v]
            if not sent or not any(hmac.compare_digest(sent, v) for v in valid):
                return refuse()
    return await call_next(request)
"""Startup reconciler: launches and check runs are worked on by this process. If the server
restarts in the middle, nothing would ever finish them, and the screens would say "running"
forever. On start we close them honestly: the plan becomes failed with "press Resume", and a
stuck check run becomes done / not passed.
"""

import json

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.models import CheckRun, Plan, utcnow

RESTART_MESSAGE = "The server restarted during your launch. Nothing was lost: press Resume to continue."


def reconcile(engine: Engine) -> dict:
    """Returns how many rows were closed: {"plans": n, "check_runs": n}."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        plans = s.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.status.in_(("approved", "running")))).all()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        for plan in plans:
            steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
            hit = next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "running"), None) or \
                next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "pending"), None)
            if hit is not None:
                hit.update(status="failed", message=RESTART_MESSAGE, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
            plan.steps_json, plan.status = json.dumps(steps), "failed"
            s.add(plan)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=plan.business_id, detail="server restarted while this launch was running")
        runs = s.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.status == "running")).all()
        for run in runs:
            run.status, run.passed, run.finished_at = "done", False, utcnow()
            s.add(run)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"run:{run.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=run.business_id, detail="server restarted while these checks were running")
        s.commit()
        return {"plans": len(plans), "check_runs": len(runs)}
"""Map a request's Host header to a seller business (or to the app itself)."""

import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.config import Settings
from app.models import Business

HOSTNAME = re.compile(r"^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*$")
SLUG = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$")  # 3-30 characters
RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = {"www", "app", "api", "admin", "mail", "email", "hello", "support", "help", "status", "login",
                       "auth", "static", "cdn", "assets", "docs", "blog", "godaddy", "airo", "launchwitness", "test",
                       "demo", "internal", "smtp", "imap", "ftp", "build", "ns1", "ns2", "autodiscover", "webmail",
                       "pay", "payment", "payments", "secure", "account", "accounts", "billing", "preview", "report"}
# Names that could pass a shop off as a well-known brand, bank or payment app.
BRAND_DENYLIST = {"godaddy", "airo", "paytm", "phonepe", "gpay", "googlepay", "google", "amazon", "flipkart",
                  "whatsapp", "instagram", "facebook", "meta", "razorpay", "upi", "bhim", "npci", "sbi", "hdfc",
                  "icici", "axis", "kotak", "paypal", "apple", "microsoft", "netflix", "swiggy", "zomato", "meesho"}


def slug_problem(slug: str) -> str | None:
    """None when `slug` may be a shop name; else one plain sentence saying why not."""
    if slug.startswith(("_", "xn--")) or not SLUG.match(slug):
        return ("A shop address needs 3 to 30 characters: small letters, numbers and dashes, "
                "starting and ending with a letter or number.")
    if slug in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS:
        return "That shop address is reserved. Please pick another."
    parts = set(slug.split("-"))
    if parts & BRAND_DENYLIST or any(slug.startswith(b) for b in BRAND_DENYLIST if len(b) >= 6):
        return "That shop address looks like a well-known brand's name. Please pick one that is clearly yours."
    return None


def normalize_host(host: str) -> str:
    """'Meera.LocalHost:8000.' -> 'meera.localhost'"""
    h = host.strip().lower()
    if h.startswith("["):  # IPv6 literal
        return h
    return h.split(":", 1)[0].rstrip(".")


def subdomain_label(host: str, settings: Settings) -> str | None:
    """The single label under APP_DOMAIN, e.g. 'meera' for meera.localhost; else None."""
    suffix = "." + settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip(".")
    if host.endswith(suffix):
        label = host[: -len(suffix)]
        if label and "." not in label:
            return label
    return None


def is_public(b: Business) -> bool:
    """A shop is on the public internet only when it is launched for real. Drafts and practice
    shops are seen only by their owner, through the preview route."""
    return b.status == "live" and not b.practice


def business_for_host(host: str, settings: Settings, session: Session) -> Business | None:
    """The PUBLIC shop for this Host (live, not practice), paused or not. None for anything else,
    so a draft, a practice shop and a name nobody took all look the same from outside."""
    h = normalize_host(host)
    if not HOSTNAME.match(h) or h == settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return None
    label = subdomain_label(h, settings)
    q = select(Business).where(Business.status == "live", Business.practice == False)  # noqa: E712
    q = q.where(Business.subdomain == label) if label is not None else q.where(Business.domain == h)
    return session.exec(q).first()


def site_url(subdomain: str, settings: Settings) -> str:
    """Public URL of a seller's sandbox site, using APP_BASE_URL's scheme and port."""
    base = urlsplit(settings.app_base_url)
    port = f":{base.port}" if base.port else ""
    return f"{base.scheme or 'http'}://{subdomain}.{settings.app_domain}{port}/"

   `X-CSRF-Token`, a value derived from that cookie which only our own pages can learn.
"""

import hmac
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, PlainTextResponse

from app.config import get_settings
from app.safety.access import csrf_for
from app.sites.hosts import normalize_host, subdomain_label

UNSAFE = {"POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"}
APP_ONLY = ("/api/", "/internal/", "/assets/", "/build", "/r/")
STALE = "This page is out of date. Please refresh it and try again."


def origin_of(value: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not value:
        return None
    u = urlsplit(value)
    return f"{u.scheme}://{u.netloc}".lower() if u.scheme and u.netloc else None


def refuse(message: str = STALE) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse({"detail": message}, status_code=403)


async def request_guard(request: Request, call_next):
    settings = request.app.dependency_overrides.get(get_settings, get_settings)()
    path = request.url.path
    on_shop_host = subdomain_label(normalize_host(request.headers.get("host", "")), settings) is not None
    if on_shop_host and (path.startswith(APP_ONLY) or path == "/api"):
        return PlainTextResponse("Not found", status_code=404)
    if request.method in UNSAFE and path.startswith("/api/"):
        origin = origin_of(request.headers.get("origin")) or origin_of(request.headers.get("referer"))
        cookie = request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie) or request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)
        if origin is None:
            if cookie:
                return refuse()
        elif origin != settings.origin:
            return refuse()
        if cookie:
            sent = request.headers.get("x-csrf-token", "")
            valid = [csrf_for(v) for v in (request.cookies.get(settings.session_cookie),
                                           request.cookies.get(settings.guest_cookie)) if v]
            if not sent or not any(hmac.compare_digest(sent, v) for v in valid):
                return refuse()
    return await call_next(request)
"""Startup reconciler: launches and check runs are worked on by this process. If the server
restarts in the middle, nothing would ever finish them, and the screens would say "running"
forever. On start we close them honestly: the plan becomes failed with "press Resume", and a
stuck check run becomes done / not passed.
"""

import json

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.models import CheckRun, Plan, utcnow

RESTART_MESSAGE = "The server restarted during your launch. Nothing was lost: press Resume to continue."


def reconcile(engine: Engine) -> dict:
    """Returns how many rows were closed: {"plans": n, "check_runs": n}."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        plans = s.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.status.in_(("approved", "running")))).all()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        for plan in plans:
            steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
            hit = next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "running"), None) or \
                next((st for st in steps if st["status"] == "pending"), None)
            if hit is not None:
                hit.update(status="failed", message=RESTART_MESSAGE, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
            plan.steps_json, plan.status = json.dumps(steps), "failed"
            s.add(plan)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=plan.business_id, detail="server restarted while this launch was running")
        runs = s.exec(select(CheckRun).where(CheckRun.status == "running")).all()
        for run in runs:
            run.status, run.passed, run.finished_at = "done", False, utcnow()
            s.add(run)
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="reconcile", target=f"run:{run.id}", result="failed",
                         business_id=run.business_id, detail="server restarted while these checks were running")
        s.commit()
        return {"plans": len(plans), "check_runs": len(runs)}
"""Map a request's Host header to a seller business (or to the app itself)."""

import re
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.config import Settings
from app.models import Business

HOSTNAME = re.compile(r"^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?)*$")
SLUG = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$")  # 3-30 characters
RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS = {"www", "app", "api", "admin", "mail", "email", "hello", "support", "help", "status", "login",
                       "auth", "static", "cdn", "assets", "docs", "blog", "godaddy", "airo", "launchwitness", "test",
                       "demo", "internal", "smtp", "imap", "ftp", "build", "ns1", "ns2", "autodiscover", "webmail",
                       "pay", "payment", "payments", "secure", "account", "accounts", "billing", "preview", "report"}
# Names that could pass a shop off as a well-known brand, bank or payment app.
BRAND_DENYLIST = {"godaddy", "airo", "paytm", "phonepe", "gpay", "googlepay", "google", "amazon", "flipkart",
                  "whatsapp", "instagram", "facebook", "meta", "razorpay", "upi", "bhim", "npci", "sbi", "hdfc",
                  "icici", "axis", "kotak", "paypal", "apple", "microsoft", "netflix", "swiggy", "zomato", "meesho"}


def slug_problem(slug: str) -> str | None:
    """None when `slug` may be a shop name; else one plain sentence saying why not."""
    if slug.startswith(("_", "xn--")) or not SLUG.match(slug):
        return ("A shop address needs 3 to 30 characters: small letters, numbers and dashes, "
                "starting and ending with a letter or number.")
    if slug in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS:
        return "That shop address is reserved. Please pick another."
    parts = set(slug.split("-"))
    if parts & BRAND_DENYLIST or any(slug.startswith(b) for b in BRAND_DENYLIST if len(b) >= 6):
        return "That shop address looks like a well-known brand's name. Please pick one that is clearly yours."
    return None


def normalize_host(host: str) -> str:
    """'Meera.LocalHost:8000.' -> 'meera.localhost'"""
    h = host.strip().lower()
    if h.startswith("["):  # IPv6 literal
        return h
    return h.split(":", 1)[0].rstrip(".")


def subdomain_label(host: str, settings: Settings) -> str | None:
    """The single label under APP_DOMAIN, e.g. 'meera' for meera.localhost; else None."""
    suffix = "." + settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip(".")
    if host.endswith(suffix):
        label = host[: -len(suffix)]
        if label and "." not in label:
            return label
    return None


def is_public(b: Business) -> bool:
    """A shop is on the public internet only when it is launched for real. Drafts and practice
    shops are seen only by their owner, through the preview route."""
    return b.status == "live" and not b.practice


def business_for_host(host: str, settings: Settings, session: Session) -> Business | None:
    """The PUBLIC shop for this Host (live, not practice), paused or not. None for anything else,
    so a draft, a practice shop and a name nobody took all look the same from outside."""
    h = normalize_host(host)
    if not HOSTNAME.match(h) or h == settings.app_domain.lower().rstrip("."):
        return None
    label = subdomain_label(h, settings)
    q = select(Business).where(Business.status == "live", Business.practice == False)  # noqa: E712
    q = q.where(Business.subdomain == label) if label is not None else q.where(Business.domain == h)
    return session.exec(q).first()


def site_url(subdomain: str, settings: Settings) -> str:
    """Public URL of a seller's sandbox site, using APP_BASE_URL's scheme and port."""
    base = urlsplit(settings.app_base_url)
    port = f":{base.port}" if base.port else ""
    return f"{base.scheme or 'http'}://{subdomain}.{settings.app_domain}{port}/"

"""Light monitoring (SPEC §7), with APScheduler.

- Every 15 minutes: site points + opens over HTTPS.
- Daily: the same, plus email settings and "settings unchanged since launch", and
  days left on the certificate and domain.
- A failure is re-checked once a minute later (rule out blips). If it still fails,
  the Doctor explains and applies a safe playbook fix; anything still broken is
  emailed to the owner's PERSONAL email (once per problem until it passes again).
- Domain expiry warnings at 30 / 7 / 1 days (renewal costs money: alert only).
  Certificate warnings at 7 / 1 days (Caddy renews certificates by itself well before that).
- Practice businesses use the fake world, so their "emails" never leave the server.

Switch off with MONITOR_ENABLED=false. Tests never start the scheduler; they call
the job methods directly.
"""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import timedelta

from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.claude_client import Claude
from app.agents.launch_check import AlreadyChecking, NotLaunched, latest_launched_plan, run_checks
from app.config import Settings
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import Alert, Business, CheckRun, utcnow
from app.safety.access import owner_emails

QUICK_MINUTES = 15
RECHECK_SECONDS = 60
QUICK_CHECKS = ["site_points", "https"]
EMAIL_CHECKS = ["email_mx", "email_spf", "email_dkim", "email_dmarc"]  # read-only on shops under the app's domain
DOMAIN_WARN_DAYS = (30, 7, 1)
CERT_WARN_DAYS = (7, 1)


def daily_checks(mode: str) -> list[str]:
    # The daily test order carries a fresh code. For an inbox we can't read it proves "form accepted ->
    # mail server accepted" only (the report says so); delivery needs the owner's tap on that email.
    return QUICK_CHECKS + EMAIL_CHECKS + ["settings_match", "test_order"]


class Monitor:
    def __init__(self, engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ_for: Callable[[Business], Integrations],
                 claude: Claude, scheduler: BackgroundScheduler | None = None):
        self.engine, self.settings, self.integ_for, self.claude = engine, settings, integ_for, claude
        self.scheduler = scheduler or BackgroundScheduler(timezone="UTC")

    # ---------- scheduler wiring ----------

    def register(self) -> None:
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.run_quick, "interval", minutes=QUICK_MINUTES, id="monitor_quick",
                               replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.run_daily, "interval", days=1, id="monitor_daily",
                               replace_existing=True, max_instances=1, coalesce=True)

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.register()
        self.scheduler.start()

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        if self.scheduler.running:
            self.scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)

    def schedule_recheck(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> None:
        self.scheduler.add_job(self.recheck, "date", run_date=utcnow() + timedelta(seconds=RECHECK_SECONDS),
                               args=[business_id, names], id=f"recheck-{business_id}", replace_existing=True)

    # ---------- jobs ----------

    def live_business_ids(self) -> list[int]:
        """Shops to watch: live, not paused. Guest practice shops are short-lived and aren't watched."""
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            return list(s.exec(select(Business.id).where(Business.status == "live", Business.paused == False,  # noqa: E712
                                                         Business.guest_hash == "")).all())

    def run_quick(self) -> None:
        for bid in self.live_business_ids():
            self.check_business(bid, "quick")

    def run_daily(self) -> None:
        for bid in self.live_business_ids():
            self.check_business(bid, "daily")

    def _context(self, business_id: int):
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            b = s.get(Business, business_id)

            return []
        failing = [f.check for f in summary.failed]

        else:
            self.resolve(business_id, names)
        if kind == "daily":
            self.expiry_alerts(business_id, summary.run_id)

    def recheck(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        """A minute later: re-check; the Doctor fixes what it safely can; alert on what's left."""
        found = self._context(business_id)

            return []
        b, plan = found

            summary = run_checks(self.engine, self.settings, self.integ_for(b), self.claude, plan.id,
                                 trigger="monitor_recheck", names=names, fix=True)
        except (NotLaunched, AlreadyChecking):
            return []
        still = summary.failed
        self.resolve(business_id, [n for n in names if n not in {f.check for f in still}])
        for f in still:
            self.alert(business_id, "check_failed", f.check,
                       subject=f"Something needs attention on {plan.site_host}",
                       body=(f"Hello,\n\nOur regular check of your website found a problem we couldn't fix by ourselves:\n\n"
                             f"  {f.plain}\n\nSign in to LaunchWitness and open your shop's report to see the details, and "
                             f"press \"Run checks now\" after any change.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))

    def resolve(self, business_id: int, names: list[str]) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as s:

        """Email the owner's personal address once per (kind, key) until resolved. True if sent."""
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            b = s.get(Business, business_id)

                                               Alert.key == key, Alert.resolved_at == None)).first()  # noqa: E711
            if open_ is not None:
                return False
            to = ", ".join(owner_emails(s, business_id))
            if not to:
                audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action=f"alert_{kind}", target=key, result="skipped",
                             business_id=business_id, detail="the shop has no signed-in owner")
                return False
            try:
                self.integ_for(b).mailer.send(to=to, subject=subject, body=body)
            except Exception as e:

                             business_id=business_id, detail=type(e).__name__)
                return False
            s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind=kind, key=key, sent_to=to))
            s.commit()
            audit.record(s, actor="monitor", action=f"alert_{kind}", target=key, result="sent",
                         business_id=business_id, detail=subject)
            return True

    def expiry_alerts(self, business_id: int, run_id: int) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as s:
            run = s.get(CheckRun, run_id)
            info = json.loads(run.info_json) if run else {}
        self._expiry(business_id, "domain_expiry", info.get("domain_days_left"), DOMAIN_WARN_DAYS,
                     lambda d: (f"Your website name ends in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}",
                                f"Hello,\n\nYour website name (domain) runs out in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}. "
                                "Renewing it costs money, so we won't do it for you. Please renew it on godaddy.com "
                                "before then, or your website and order emails will stop working.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))
        self._expiry(business_id, "cert_expiry", info.get("cert_days_left"), CERT_WARN_DAYS,
                     lambda d: (f"Your website's security certificate ends in {d} day{'s' if d != 1 else ''}",
                                f"Hello,\n\nYour website's security certificate (the padlock) runs out in {d} "
                                f"day{'s' if d != 1 else ''} and hasn't renewed itself yet. It costs nothing and you "
                                "don't need to do anything — we're looking into it.\n\n— LaunchWitness"))

    def _expiry(self, business_id: int, kind: str, days: int | None, thresholds: tuple[int, ...], text) -> None:
        if days is None:
            return
        crossed = [t for t in thresholds if days <= t]
        if not crossed:  # renewed (or far away): clear old warnings so the next cycle warns again
            with Session(self.engine) as s:
                for a in s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                                    Alert.resolved_at == None)).all():  # noqa: E711
                    a.resolved_at = utcnow()
                    s.add(a)
                s.commit()
            return
        nearest = min(crossed)
        subject, body = text(max(days, 0))
        if self.alert(business_id, kind, f"{nearest}d", subject=subject, body=body):
            with Session(self.engine) as s:  # skip the bigger thresholds we're already past
                for t in crossed:
                    seen = s.exec(select(Alert).where(Alert.business_id == business_id, Alert.kind == kind,
                                                      Alert.key == f"{t}d", Alert.resolved_at == None)).first()  # noqa: E711
                    if t != nearest and seen is None:
                        s.add(Alert(business_id=business_id, kind=kind, key=f"{t}d", sent_to="(skipped)"))
                s.commit()

"""Exactly one app process per database.

The monitor (APScheduler) runs inside the app process, and SQLite has one writer. Two app
processes on the same database would mean two copies of every alert email and every daily test
order. So the app takes an exclusive lock on a file next to the database at startup and refuses
to start if another process already holds it (e.g. someone ran uvicorn with `--workers 4`).
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path

_held = None  # keep the file object (and so the lock) for the life of the process


class SecondProcess(RuntimeError):
    pass


def lock_path(database_url: str) -> Path | None:
    if not database_url.startswith("sqlite:///") or database_url.endswith(":memory:"):
        return None
    return Path(database_url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")).with_suffix(".lock")


def acquire(database_url: str) -> bool:
    """True when this process now holds the lock (or no lock applies). Raises SecondProcess otherwise."""
    global _held
    workers = os.environ.get("WEB_CONCURRENCY", "1").strip() or "1"
    if workers != "1":
        raise SecondProcess(f"WEB_CONCURRENCY={workers}: LaunchWitness must run as ONE process (scheduler + SQLite).")
    path = lock_path(database_url)
    if path is None or _held is not None:
        return True
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = open(path, "a+")
    try:
        if os.name == "nt":
            import msvcrt

            f.seek(0)
            msvcrt.locking(f.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
        else:
            import fcntl

            fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except OSError as e:
        f.close()
        raise SecondProcess(f"Another LaunchWitness process already uses {path.parent}. Run exactly one "
                            "(one uvicorn worker, one app container).") from e
    _held = f
    return True


def release() -> None:
    global _held
    if _held is not None:
        _held.close()
        _held = None

    """Set on EVERY new connection: wait up to 5 s for a lock instead of failing at once, enforce

"""Database engine and session helpers (SQLite via SQLModel)."""

from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool
from sqlmodel import Session, SQLModel, create_engine

from app import models  # noqa: F401  (registers tables on SQLModel.metadata)
from app.config import get_settings

_engine: Engine | None = None


BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000


def _sqlite_pragmas(dbapi_conn, _record, *, wal: bool) -> None:
    """Set on EVERY new connection: wait up to 5 s for a lock instead of failing at once, enforce
    foreign keys, and (file databases) use WAL so readers never block the one writer."""
    cur = dbapi_conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
    cur.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    if wal:
        cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        cur.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")  # safe with WAL; a power cut loses at most the last commit
    cur.close()


def make_engine(database_url: str) -> Engine:
    if database_url in ("sqlite://", "sqlite:///:memory:"):
        # One shared in-memory DB across threads (tests).
        engine = create_engine(
            "sqlite://",
            connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
            poolclass=StaticPool,
        )
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=False))
        return engine
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite:///"):
        Path(database_url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    engine = create_engine(database_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=True))
    return engine


def get_engine() -> Engine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        _engine = make_engine(get_settings().database_url)
    return _engine


def add_missing_columns(engine: Engine) -> list[str]:
    """Tiny forward-only migration: a table that already exists gets any column the models added
    since (SQLite `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` with the model's default). Never drops or rewrites."""
    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

    added: list[str] = []
    insp = inspect(engine)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for table in SQLModel.metadata.sorted_tables:
            if not insp.has_table(table.name):
                continue
            have = {c["name"] for c in insp.get_columns(table.name)}
            for col in table.columns:
                if col.name in have:
                    continue
                default = col.default.arg if col.default is not None and not callable(col.default.arg) else None
                ddl = f'ALTER TABLE "{table.name}" ADD COLUMN "{col.name}" {col.type.compile(engine.dialect)}'
                if default is not None:
                    value = int(default) if isinstance(default, bool) else default
                    ddl += " DEFAULT " + (str(value) if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'")
                conn.execute(text(ddl))
                added.append(f"{table.name}.{col.name}")
    return added


def init_db(engine: Engine | None = None) -> None:
    engine = engine or get_engine()
    SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
    add_missing_columns(engine)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    """FastAPI dependency. Tests override this."""
    with Session(get_engine()) as session:
        yield session

from sqlmodel import Session, delete, select

from app.config import Settings

    ShopReport,
    utcnow,
)
from app.sites.hosts import is_public

GUEST_HOURS = 24


def unpublish(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
    """Take a real shop off the internet: remove its address record (through the guarded client)
    and mark it not live. Best effort on the record: the shop is unpublished either way."""
    if not is_public(b):
        return
    try:
        if b.subdomain:
            integ.godaddy.delete_records(settings.app_domain, "A", b.subdomain)
        result, detail = "ok", "address record removed"
    except Exception as e:  # the page is gone anyway (status), the stray record points at a 404
        result, detail = "failed", type(e).__name__
    b.status = "draft"
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()

    """Delete a shop and everything personal that hangs off it (orders hold customers' names and

        session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == b.id))

class Evidence(SQLModel, table=True):
    """One proven hop of a check, stored as it happened (S9F Phase 3). The report only claims what is here."""

    step: str  # dns_answer | http_response | form_post | smtp_accepted | imap_seen | owner_confirmed

    source: str = ""  # which server or tool gave the answer, e.g. "ns1.domaincontrol.com", "imap.secureserver.net"

    message_id: str = ""
    nonce: str = ""
    status_code: int | None = None
    cert_not_after: datetime | None = None
    answer: str = ""  # DNS answer or a short excerpt

    """A test order the checker is about to place. The form POST carries `lw_test=<nonce>`; only an open
    ticket for that shop turns the POST into a hidden test order. The test email's "Yes, I got it" link
    carries a second random token; only its SHA-256 is stored, and it works once."""

    id: int | None = Field(default=None, primary_key=True)
    business_id: int = Field(foreign_key="business.id", index=True)
    run_id: int | None = Field(default=None, index=True)
    nonce: str = Field(index=True, unique=True)
    confirm_hash: str = Field(default="", index=True)
    order_id: int | None = None
    used_at: datetime | None = None  # the form POST used it
    confirmed_at: datetime | None = None  # the owner tapped "Yes, I got it"
    created_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=utcnow)

"""Session 10: production readiness (database settings, one process, row deletes, migrations)."""

import sqlite3

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import singleton
from app.db import BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS, init_db, make_engine
from app.models import Business, Evidence, ReportShare, TestTicket


def test_sqlite_pragmas_on_every_connection(tmp_path):
    engine = make_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/lw.db")
    for _ in range(2):  # a fresh pool connection each time
        with engine.connect() as c:
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA journal_mode").scalar() == "wal"
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA busy_timeout").scalar() == BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA foreign_keys").scalar() == 1
        engine.dispose()


def test_foreign_keys_enforced_in_memory_too():
    engine = make_engine("sqlite://")
    init_db(engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        s.add(Evidence(business_id=999, check="https", step="http_response"))
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            s.commit()


def test_second_process_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    url = f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/lw.db"
    monkeypatch.setattr(singleton, "_held", None)
    assert singleton.acquire(url)
    held = singleton._held
    monkeypatch.setattr(singleton, "_held", None)  # pretend to be a second process
    with pytest.raises(singleton.SecondProcess):
        singleton.acquire(url)
    held.close()


def test_many_workers_refused(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("WEB_CONCURRENCY", "4")
    with pytest.raises(singleton.SecondProcess):
        singleton.acquire("sqlite://")

        s.add(TestTicket(business_id=b.id, nonce="n-gone"))
        s.add(ReportShare(business_id=b.id, token_hash="h-gone"))
        s.commit()
        bid = b.id

async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    from app import singleton

    # ONE process only: the scheduler runs in-process and SQLite has one writer. A second worker

"""Session 10: production readiness (database settings, one process, row deletes, migrations)."""

import sqlite3

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import singleton
from app.db import BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS, init_db, make_engine
from app.models import Business, Evidence, ReportShare, TestTicket


def test_sqlite_pragmas_on_every_connection(tmp_path):
    engine = make_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/lw.db")
    for _ in range(2):  # a fresh pool connection each time
        with engine.connect() as c:
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA journal_mode").scalar() == "wal"
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA busy_timeout").scalar() == BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
            assert c.exec_driver_sql("PRAGMA foreign_keys").scalar() == 1
        engine.dispose()


def test_foreign_keys_enforced_in_memory_too():
    engine = make_engine("sqlite://")
    init_db(engine)
    with Session(engine) as s:
        s.add(Evidence(business_id=999, check="https", step="http_response"))
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            s.commit()


def test_second_process_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    url = f"sqlite:///{tmp_path}/lw.db"
    monkeypatch.setattr(singleton, "_held", None)
    assert singleton.acquire(url)
    held = singleton._held
    monkeypatch.setattr(singleton, "_held", None)  # pretend to be a second process
    with pytest.raises(singleton.SecondProcess):
        singleton.acquire(url)
    held.close()


def test_many_workers_refused(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("WEB_CONCURRENCY", "4")
    with pytest.raises(singleton.SecondProcess):
        singleton.acquire("sqlite://")


def test_admin_practice_delete_removes_proof_rows(client, engine, settings):
    """Bug fixed in S10: the demo-reset delete left Evidence / TestTicket / ReportShare rows behind."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        b = Business(name="Gone", description="", subdomain="gone-shop", practice=True)
        s.add(b)
        s.commit()
        s.refresh(b)
        s.add(Evidence(business_id=b.id, check="https", step="http_response"))
        s.add(TestTicket(business_id=b.id, nonce="n-gone"))
        s.add(ReportShare(business_id=b.id, token_hash="h-gone"))
        s.commit()
        bid = b.id
    r = client.delete(f"/api/admin/practice-businesses/{bid}", headers={"X-Admin-Token": settings.admin_token.get_secret_value()})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    with Session(engine) as s:
        for table in (Evidence, TestTicket, ReportShare):
            assert s.exec(select(table).where(table.business_id == bid)).first() is None

"""Send mail through the app's one mailbox (GoDaddy Professional Email, secureserver.net).

Port 465 = implicit SSL (default). Port 587 = STARTTLS. If an SSL connection to 465 can't be
made at all (blocked port, timeout, TLS handshake error), we try 587 STARTTLS once. We never
fall back after login has started, so a message can't be sent twice and a wrong password
isn't retried. Host, port, user and password come only from settings (env vars).
"""

import logging
import smtplib
import ssl
from email.message import EmailMessage
from email.utils import make_msgid
from typing import Protocol

from app.config import Settings

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

STARTTLS_PORT = 587
TIMEOUT_S = 30


class Mailer(Protocol):
    def send(self, *, to: str, subject: str, body: str, html: str | None = None) -> str: ...


class SmtpMailer:
    def __init__(self, settings: Settings):
        self.host = settings.smtp_host
        self.port = settings.smtp_port
        self.user = settings.smtp_user
        self._password = settings.smtp_password

    def _connect(self) -> smtplib.SMTP:
        context = ssl.create_default_context()
        if self.port != STARTTLS_PORT:
            try:
                return smtplib.SMTP_SSL(self.host, self.port, context=context, timeout=TIMEOUT_S)
            except (ConnectionError, TimeoutError, ssl.SSLError, smtplib.SMTPConnectError,
                    smtplib.SMTPServerDisconnected) as e:
                log.warning("SMTP SSL to %s:%s failed (%s); trying port %s with STARTTLS",
                            self.host, self.port, type(e).__name__, STARTTLS_PORT)
        s = smtplib.SMTP(self.host, STARTTLS_PORT, timeout=TIMEOUT_S)
        try:
            s.starttls(context=context)
        except Exception:
            s.close()
            raise
        return s

    def send(self, *, to: str, subject: str, body: str, html: str | None = None) -> str:
        msg = EmailMessage()
        msg["From"] = self.user
        msg["To"] = to
        msg["Subject"] = subject
        msg["Message-ID"] = make_msgid(domain=self.user.split("@")[-1])
        msg.set_content(body)
        if html:
            msg.add_alternative(html, subtype="html")
        with self._connect() as s:
            s.login(self.user, self._password.get_secret_value())
            s.send_message(msg)
        return msg["Message-ID"]


class FakeMailer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.sent: list[dict] = []

    def send(self, *, to: str, subject: str, body: str, html: str | None = None) -> str:
        message_id = f"<fake-{len(self.sent) + 1}@launchwitness.test>"
        self.sent.append({"to": to, "subject": subject, "body": body, "html": html, "message_id": message_id})
        return message_id


def get_mailer() -> Mailer:
    """FastAPI dependency. Tests override this with a FakeMailer."""
    from app.config import get_settings

    return SmtpMailer(get_settings())

@pytest.mark.parametrize("host,code", [("app:8000", 200), ("app", 200), ("127.0.0.1:8000", 200),
                                        ("localhost", 404), ("launchwitness.com", 404), ("meera.localhost", 404),

def test_internal_only_for_private_host_names(client, settings, host, code):
    # settings.app_domain is "localhost" in tests: the app's own (public) name, so internal must refuse it.
    want = 404 if host == "localhost" else code
    r = client.get("/internal/tls-ask", params={"domain": settings.app_domain}, headers={"host": host})

    assert make_settings(smtp_security="plain", smtp_host="mailpit").smtp_security == "plain"

"""Session 9F Phase 3: the order proof chain, shared reports, and "Check any address"."""

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta

import httpx
import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import proof
from app.checks.dns_resolver import AuthoritativeResolver
from app.checks.safe_fetch import Page, Refused, SafeWeb
from app.models import AddressCheck, AuditEvent, Business, Evidence, Order, ReportShare, TestTicket
from app.routers.health import mailbox_warning
from app.routers.proof import get_public_dns, get_public_web
from tests.conftest import publish, set_user, sign_in
from tests.test_m3_launch import approve, meera, plan
from tests.test_m4_report import real_plan, two_worlds_client
from tests.test_s9_phase2_access import make_app


def report(c, biz):
    r = c.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def hops(engine, check="test_order"):
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return [e.step for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.check == check).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()]


# ---------- hops recorded separately, practice labelled ----------

def test_practice_launch_records_each_hop_with_times(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "imap_seen"]
    assert hops(engine, "site_points") == ["dns_answer"] and hops(engine, "https") == ["http_response"]
    with Session(engine) as s:
        rows = s.exec(select(Evidence)).all()
        assert all(e.practice for e in rows)  # pretend world: always labelled
        smtp = next(e for e in rows if e.step == "smtp_accepted")
        assert smtp.message_id and smtp.nonce and smtp.server == "pretend mail server"
        assert next(e for e in rows if e.step == "dns_answer").server == "pretend nameserver"
    rep = report(client, biz)
    assert rep["practice"] is True and rep["proof"]["proven"] == rep["proof"]["total"] == 7
    test = next(c for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "test_order")
    assert [h["title"] for h in test["hops"]] == ["Form accepted", "Mail server accepted", "In the inbox"]
    assert all(h["at"] for h in test["hops"]) and rep["proof"]["stale"] is False


def test_test_order_goes_through_the_public_form_and_stays_hidden(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    with Session(engine) as s:
        order = s.exec(select(Order)).one()
        ticket = s.exec(select(TestTicket)).one()
        assert order.is_test and order.nonce == ticket.nonce and ticket.order_id == order.id and ticket.used_at
        assert order.client_token  # the form's own hidden token was posted back, like a browser does
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/orders").json() == []  # hidden from the seller's list
def test_accepted_is_not_delivered_until_the_owner_taps(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):
    c, server, _practice = two_worlds_client(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude)
    with c:
        sign_in(c, "meera@example.org")
        set_user(engine, "meera@example.org", status="approved")
        biz = meera(c)
        approve(c, real_plan(c, biz))
        assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted"]  # no inbox we can read: no "delivered"
        rep = report(c, biz)
        test = next(x for x in rep["run"]["checks"] if x["check"] == "test_order")
        assert test["state"] == "needs_you" and "accepted" in test["plain"]
        assert "arrived" not in test["plain"] and rep["ready"] is False
        mail = next(m for m in server.mailer.sent if "[TEST]" in m["subject"])
        token = mail["body"].split("#/got-it?token=", 1)[1].split()[0]
        assert c.get("/").status_code == 200  # opening the link's page uses nothing up
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": token}).status_code == 200
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": token}).status_code == 400  # single use
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": "made-up"}).status_code == 400
        assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "owner_confirmed"]
        assert report(c, biz)["ready"] is True

def report(c, biz):
    r = c.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def hops(engine, check="test_order"):
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return [e.step for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.check == check).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()]


# ---------- hops recorded separately, practice labelled ----------

def test_practice_launch_records_each_hop_with_times(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "imap_seen"]
    assert hops(engine, "site_points") == ["dns_answer"] and hops(engine, "https") == ["http_response"]
    with Session(engine) as s:
        rows = s.exec(select(Evidence)).all()
        assert all(e.practice for e in rows)  # pretend world: always labelled
        smtp = next(e for e in rows if e.step == "smtp_accepted")
        assert smtp.message_id and smtp.nonce and smtp.server == "pretend mail server"
        assert next(e for e in rows if e.step == "dns_answer").server == "pretend nameserver"
    rep = report(client, biz)
    assert rep["practice"] is True and rep["proof"]["proven"] == rep["proof"]["total"] == 7
    test = next(c for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "test_order")
    assert [h["title"] for h in test["hops"]] == ["Form accepted", "Mail server accepted", "In the inbox"]
    assert all(h["at"] for h in test["hops"]) and rep["proof"]["stale"] is False


def test_test_order_goes_through_the_public_form_and_stays_hidden(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    with Session(engine) as s:
        order = s.exec(select(Order)).one()
        ticket = s.exec(select(TestTicket)).one()
        assert order.is_test and order.nonce == ticket.nonce and ticket.order_id == order.id and ticket.used_at
        assert order.client_token  # the form's own hidden token was posted back, like a browser does
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/orders").json() == []  # hidden from the seller's list
def test_accepted_is_not_delivered_until_the_owner_taps(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude):
    c, server, _practice = two_worlds_client(make_settings, engine, mailer, claude)
    with c:
        sign_in(c, "meera@example.org")
        set_user(engine, "meera@example.org", status="approved")
        biz = meera(c)
        approve(c, real_plan(c, biz))
        assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted"]  # no inbox we can read: no "delivered"
        rep = report(c, biz)
        test = next(x for x in rep["run"]["checks"] if x["check"] == "test_order")
        assert test["state"] == "needs_you" and "accepted" in test["plain"]
        assert "arrived" not in test["plain"] and rep["ready"] is False
        mail = next(m for m in server.mailer.sent if "[TEST]" in m["subject"])
        token = mail["body"].split("#/got-it?token=", 1)[1].split()[0]
        assert c.get("/").status_code == 200  # opening the link's page uses nothing up
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": token}).status_code == 200
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": token}).status_code == 400  # single use
        assert c.post("/api/proof/confirm", json={"token": "made-up"}).status_code == 400
        assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "owner_confirmed"]
        assert report(c, biz)["ready"] is True

def launch_then_check(engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, claude: Claude, plan_id: int) -> str:
    """Run the plan; when it finishes, prove it works (checks + Doctor repairs)."""
    status = run_plan(engine, settings, integ, plan_id)
    if status == "done":
        try:
            run_checks(engine, settings, integ, claude, plan_id, trigger="launch")
        except AlreadyChecking:  # a check for this shop is already running; its result is the proof
            pass
    return status


def _start(background: BackgroundTasks, session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, claude: Claude,
           plan: Plan) -> None:
    background.add_task(launch_then_check, session.get_bind(), settings, integ, claude, plan.id)


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/approve")
def approve_plan(body: ApproveRequest, request: Request, background: BackgroundTasks,
                 plan: Annotated[Plan, Depends(require_plan_access)],
                 actor: ActorDep,
                 settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
                 integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    if plan.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This plan was already approved.")
    running = active_plan(session, plan.business_id)
    if running is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Another launch is already running for this business.")
    visitor, admin = visitor_id(request), actor.is_admin
    if not admin and launches_today(session, visitor) >= settings.visitor_launches_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've launched several shops today already. "
                            "Please come back tomorrow to launch another one.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    integ = integ_for(plan)

    if not plan.practice:
        # A real launch puts a shop on the public internet under our name. Checked again here, at the
        # moment of approval: the account, the certificate budget, and the go-live policy check.
        if not actor.approved or b.guest_hash or plan.mode != "sandbox":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=NOT_APPROVED)
        if not (b.status == "live" and not b.practice) and live_shops(session) >= settings.max_live_shops:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="We've reached the number of live shops we can host this week. "
                                "Nothing was changed. Please try again in a few days.")
        if b.paused:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This shop is paused by our team, so it can't be launched right now.")
        if b.review != "cleared":  # "cleared" = the team already looked
            verdict = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json))
            b.review, b.review_reason = ("ok", "") if verdict.ok else ("held", verdict.reason)
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}",
                         result="ok" if verdict.ok else "held", business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                         detail=f"by {verdict.by}: {verdict.reason}"[:300])
            if not verdict.ok:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{verdict.reason} Nothing was launched. "
                                    "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.practice:  # from here on the shop is real: old practice results no longer count
            b.practice, b.status = False, "draft"
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id,
                                                    Business.practice == b.practice)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status, plan.visitor, plan.approved_at = "approved", ("" if admin else visitor), utcnow()
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                 detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, {'practice' if plan.practice else 'REAL'}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/resume")
def resume_plan(background: BackgroundTasks, plan: Annotated[Plan, Depends(require_plan_access)],
                settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
                integ_for: Annotated[IntegFor, Depends(integrations_for)]) -> dict:
    if plan.status not in ("failed", "blocked"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only a stopped launch can be resumed.")
    reset_for_resume(session, plan)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="resume_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=plan.business_id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ_for(plan), claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}

        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="You've launched several shops today already. "
                            "Please come back tomorrow to launch another one.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    integ = integ_for(plan)

    if not plan.practice:
        # A real launch puts a shop on the public internet under our name. Checked again here, at the
        # moment of approval: the account, the certificate budget, and the go-live policy check.
        if not actor.approved or b.guest_hash or plan.mode != "sandbox":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=NOT_APPROVED)
        if not (b.status == "live" and not b.practice) and live_shops(session) >= settings.max_live_shops:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="We've reached the number of live shops we can host this week. "
                                "Nothing was changed. Please try again in a few days.")
        if b.paused:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This shop is paused by our team, so it can't be launched right now.")
        if b.review != "cleared":  # "cleared" = the team already looked
            verdict = policy_check(claude, Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json))
            b.review, b.review_reason = ("ok", "") if verdict.ok else ("held", verdict.reason)
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()
            audit.record(session, actor="policy", action="policy_check", target=f"business:{b.id}",
                         result="ok" if verdict.ok else "held", business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                         detail=f"by {verdict.by}: {verdict.reason}"[:300])
            if not verdict.ok:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=f"{verdict.reason} Nothing was launched. "
                                    "We'll email you when our team has looked at it.")
        if b.practice:  # from here on the shop is real: old practice results no longer count
            b.practice, b.status = False, "draft"
            session.add(b)
            session.commit()

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id,
                                                    Business.practice == b.practice)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status, plan.visitor, plan.approved_at = "approved", ("" if admin else visitor), utcnow()
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, user_id=actor.user_id,
                 detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, {'practice' if plan.practice else 'REAL'}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/resume")
def resume_plan(background: BackgroundTasks, plan: Annotated[Plan, Depends(require_plan_access)],
                settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],

                claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],

    reset_for_resume(session, plan)

                 business_id=plan.business_id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ_for(plan), claude, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}

    q = select(User).where(User.status != "deleted")
    if status:

                 detail=f"{len(rows)} row(s), status={status or 'any'}")
    return [user_out(session, u) for u in rows]

"""FastAPI dependency: ordinary public DNS lookups (read-only). Tests override this."""
    return RealDnsResolver()


def get_public_web() -> SafeWeb:
    """FastAPI dependency: any public https host, SSRF-guarded. Tests override this."""
    return SafeWeb(lambda _h: True, timeout=8.0)


def clean_address(raw: str) -> str | None:
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit

    from app.checks.safe_fetch import is_ip_literal
    from app.sites.hosts import HOSTNAME

    text = raw.strip().lower()
    if "://" not in text:
        text = "https://" + text
    host = (urlsplit(text).hostname or "").rstrip(".")
    if not host or "." not in host or is_ip_literal(host) or not HOSTNAME.match(host) or host.endswith(".local"):
        return None
    return host


@router.post("/api/check-address")
def check_address(body: Address, request: Request, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                  session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                  dns: Annotated[DnsResolver, Depends(get_public_dns)],
                  web: Annotated[SafeWeb, Depends(get_public_web)]) -> dict:
    """Read-only public checks of any web address, in plain English. Sends no email, stores nothing
    about the address (only a hashed visitor + time, for the rate limit)."""
    host = clean_address(body.address)
    if host is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Please type a web address, like myshop.com.")
    visitor = visitor_id(request)
    hour_ago = utcnow() - timedelta(hours=1)
    mine = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(AddressCheck).where(
        AddressCheck.visitor == visitor, AddressCheck.created_at >= hour_ago)).one()
    everyone = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(AddressCheck).where(
        AddressCheck.created_at >= utcnow() - timedelta(days=1))).one()
    if mine >= settings.address_checks_per_hour or everyone >= settings.address_checks_per_day:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=429, detail="That's a lot of checks for now. Please try again in an hour.")
    session.add(AddressCheck(visitor=visitor))
    session.commit()
    return {"address": host, "read_only": True, "results": address_results(host, dns, web)}


def address_results(host: str, dns: DnsResolver, web: SafeWeb) -> list[dict]:
    out = []

    def add(check: str, ok: bool | None, plain: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
        out.append({"check": check, "ok": ok, "plain": plain, "detail": detail})

    a = dns.resolve(host, "A") + dns.resolve(host, "AAAA")
    add("address", bool(a), "The address leads to a website server." if a else "The address doesn't lead anywhere.",
        ", ".join(a))
    if a:
        try:
            page = web.get(f"https://{host}/")
            ok = page.status is not None and page.status < 400
            add("https", ok, "The website opens securely." if ok else
                "The website didn't open securely." if not page.cert_valid else "The website didn't open.",
                f"status {page.status} {page.error}".strip())
            end = web.cert_not_after(host) if ok else None
            if end is not None:
                days = (end - datetime.now(UTC)).days
                add("certificate", days > 7, f"The security certificate is good for {days} more days."
                    if days > 7 else f"The security certificate runs out in {days} days.", end.date().isoformat())
        except Refused as e:
            add("https", None, str(e))
    zone = host.removeprefix("www.")
    mx = dns.resolve(zone, "MX")
    add("email_mx", bool(mx), "Emails to this address have somewhere to go." if mx else
        "This address can't receive email.", ", ".join(mx))
    txt = [t.strip('"') for t in dns.resolve(zone, "TXT")]
    spf = [t for t in txt if t.lower().startswith("v=spf1")]
    add("email_spf", bool(spf), "It says which servers may send its email." if spf else
        "It doesn't say which servers may send its email, so its emails may land in spam.", "; ".join(spf))
    dmarc = [t.strip('"') for t in dns.resolve(f"_dmarc.{zone}", "TXT") if "dmarc1" in t.lower()]
    add("email_dmarc", bool(dmarc), "It is protected against fake emails in its name." if dmarc else
        "It isn't protected against fake emails in its name.", "; ".join(dmarc))
    return out

    return {"address": host, "read_only": True, "results": address_results(host, dns, web)}


def address_results(host: str, dns: DnsResolver, web: SafeWeb) -> list[dict]:
    out = []

    def add(check: str, ok: bool | None, plain: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
        out.append({"check": check, "ok": ok, "plain": plain, "detail": detail})

    a = dns.resolve(host, "A") + dns.resolve(host, "AAAA")
    add("address", bool(a), "The address leads to a website server." if a else "The address doesn't lead anywhere.",
        ", ".join(a))
    if a:
        try:
            page = web.get(f"https://{host}/")
            ok = page.status is not None and page.status < 400
            add("https", ok, "The website opens securely." if ok else
                "The website didn't open securely." if not page.cert_valid else "The website didn't open.",
                f"status {page.status} {page.error}".strip())
            end = web.cert_not_after(host) if ok else None
            if end is not None:
                days = (end - datetime.now(UTC)).days
                add("certificate", days > 7, f"The security certificate is good for {days} more days."
                    if days > 7 else f"The security certificate runs out in {days} days.", end.date().isoformat())
        except Refused as e:
            add("https", None, str(e))
    zone = host.removeprefix("www.")
    mx = dns.resolve(zone, "MX")
    add("email_mx", bool(mx), "Emails to this address have somewhere to go." if mx else
        "This address can't receive email.", ", ".join(mx))
    txt = [t.strip('"') for t in dns.resolve(zone, "TXT")]
    spf = [t for t in txt if t.lower().startswith("v=spf1")]
    add("email_spf", bool(spf), "It says which servers may send its email." if spf else
        "It doesn't say which servers may send its email, so its emails may land in spam.", "; ".join(spf))
    dmarc = [t.strip('"') for t in dns.resolve(f"_dmarc.{zone}", "TXT") if "dmarc1" in t.lower()]
    add("email_dmarc", bool(dmarc), "It is protected against fake emails in its name." if dmarc else
        "It isn't protected against fake emails in its name.", "; ".join(dmarc))
    return out

    with Session(engine) as session:

            return plan.status
        ctx = Ctx(session, settings, integ, plan, business)

        for st in steps:
            if st["status"] in ("done", "skipped"):

            st.update(status="running", message="", started_at=utcnow().isoformat(), finished_at=None)

            except StepFailed as e:
                st.update(status=e.status, message=e.message, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())

"""Restart drill for the local production-like stack (deploy/README.md). Runs INSIDE the app container:

    docker compose ... exec -T app python - < scripts/restart_drill.py start     # practice launch, prints plan id
    docker compose ... exec -T app python - < scripts/restart_drill.py <plan_id> # after the kill: its state

`start` makes a practice shop for a throwaway user straight in the database and approves a practice plan
through the API on localhost:8000 (inside the container, as the shop's owner), so a launch is running when
the caller kills the container. Never touches anything real (practice + pretend world only).
"""

import json
import sys
import urllib.request

from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.config import get_settings
from app.db import get_engine
from app.models import Plan

arg = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "start"
engine = get_engine()

if arg == "start":
    from app.accounts import create_session
    from app.models import Business, Membership, User
    from app.safety.access import csrf_for

    s = get_settings()
    with Session(engine) as db:
        u = User(email=f"restart-drill-{__import__('secrets').token_hex(3)}@example.test", status="approved")
        db.add(u)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(u)
        raw = create_session(db, s, u, "restart-drill")
        profile = json.load(open("tests/fixtures/sellers/meera_cakes.json", encoding="utf-8"))
        b = Business(name="Restart drill", description=profile["description"], subdomain=f"drill{u.id}",
                     practice=True, profile_json=json.dumps({"name": "Restart drill", "products": [
                         {"name": "Cake", "price_inr": 500}]}))
        db.add(b)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(b)
        db.add(Membership(user_id=u.id, business_id=b.id, role="owner"))
        db.commit()
        bid = b.id

    def call(method, path, body=None):
        req = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:8000{path}", method=method,
                                     data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                     headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Origin": s.origin,
                                              "Cookie": f"{s.session_cookie}={raw}", "X-CSRF-Token": csrf_for(raw)})
        return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20))

    plan = call("POST", f"/api/businesses/{bid}/plans", {"mode": "sandbox"})
    call("POST", f"/api/plans/{plan['id']}/approve", {"approved_by": "drill"})
    print(plan["id"])
else:
    with Session(engine) as db:
        p = db.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.id == int(arg))).one()
        steps = json.loads(p.steps_json)
        print(json.dumps({"plan_status": p.status,
                          "messages": [st["message"] for st in steps if st["status"] in ("failed", "running")],
                          "still_running": [st["kind"] for st in steps if st["status"] == "running"]}))
